title: UltimateBaltop
description: This is a baltop plugin with gui and smooth performance
body:
**UltimateBaltop – Modern GUI Money Leaderboards**

UltimateBaltop is a modern and lightweight Minecraft plugin that displays player money rankings in a clean and interactive GUI.

Instead of using plain text leaderboards, UltimateBaltop provides a stylish graphical interface where players can easily view the richest players on the server in real time.

**✨ Features:**

- Interactive GUI-based baltop leaderboard
- Displays the richest players on the server
- Clean and modern interface
- Lightweight and optimized performance
- Real-time balance updates
- Easy setup and configuration
- Supports economy plugins

**💰 Command:**

- `/baltop` – Open the money leaderboard GUI

**💡 Why use UltimateBaltop?**

Traditional baltop commands can look outdated and difficult to read. UltimateBaltop improves the experience with a visually appealing GUI that makes leaderboards more engaging and professional for your server.

**📌 Perfect for:**

- SMP servers
- Economy servers
- Survival servers
- Competitive communities

**Show off the richest players in style with UltimateBaltop!**
